title: MAS OTel SDK span (JSONL line)
description: One line of otel_sdk_spans.jsonl. Envelope for MAS Framework OTel export; per-span shapes are validated by mas.spanspec.yaml (SpanValidator L1–L4). Aligned with mas-ontology-kg App. E / App. P.

name.description: MAS span class (AgentCall, LLMCall, ToolCall, CallAnnotation, …)

parent_id.description: OTel parent span id; omitted or null for roots

attributes.description: Span attributes; MAS semantic fields use mas.* prefix

application_id.description: Only stamped on the *.graph span (an OXP-ingest requirement) and, as application.id, on session.start. Other spans rely on the OTel resource's service.name instead -- norm's get_application_id() already falls back to it, matching the real ioa-observe-sdk, which never sets this on ordinary call spans either.
